author: han0110
content:
Yes zkBoost no longer provides verification api, and integration with Ere verifier directly would be most straightforward, but integration with upstream verifier will also work (just currently the vks and proofs de/serialization are defined by Ere).

There are some EIP-8025 testing fixtures in zkBoost repo for testing https://github.com/eth-act/zkboost/tree/master/crates/mock-beacon-node/tests/fixture (vks and valid proofs and their public values).

author: taulepton_
content: You can find an example of how we ship the C bindings of ere in our fork of lighthouse here - https://github.com/eth-act/lighthouse/tree/optional-proofs/beacon_node/proof_engine

author: taulepton_
content: <@531934490826768418> also implemented a go port of ere that I'd encourage him to share with you so you can decide for yourself how to proceed

author: manunlp
content:
Note: right now `go-ere` does **not** build the `.a` files from source. It only copies them from the ere releases.
Before going to prod, we want to compile everything from source however.

author: latentstate
content:
